summary: Microsoft's total funding commitments to OpenAI are $13B, of which $11.8B was funded by March 31, 2026; about a 24% stake by September 2026.
notes: Cumulative commitments made in tranches since 2019, as reported in Microsoft's 10-Qs. The announced date is the as-of date of the first 10-Q figure used, not of any single tranche. The stake fell from about 27% after the October 2025 recapitalization to about 24% by September 30, 2026. The value of the stake is a valuation, not money paid, so it is not stored as an amount.
